observations.why: The verb 'switching' frames adoption of a novel database as the appealed-to good — novelty and self-direction in technology choice.
Performance gain and cost reduction appeal to achievement (winning via superior metrics) and competence (mastery of capability); both are named as the goods that justify the switch.
The arrow notation frames the migration as a directional move toward novelty, restating the openness-to-change appeal in summary form.
Quantifying a tenfold capability gain directly appeals to competence — mastery and quality of analytical craft as the good.
Pinpointing a concrete delivery quarter frames the migration as a mastery milestone — competence expressed through committed, measurable execution.
